verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no machine-readable API spec for GitHub Mobile. The REST and GraphQL API docs belong to the host GitHub platform, not the mobile app, and neither says a spec is downloadable. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and llms.txt is a docs index rather than an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
